verses.text: Masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado ajun yet' winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' pax winhaj Jezanías yuninal winhaj Osaías yet' masanil heb' anima, heb' ay yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, ix jawi heb' t'ayin Jeremías schekab' in Dios tik.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ay wal jun tas ol ko k'an t'ayach tikne'ik, manh a tenek' t'ayonh: Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal kuj jaywanh onh ix onh kan ik. Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, tzijtum ko b'eyi, palta haxo tikne'ik haxonhej jaywanh onh ayonhek' tik onh kani.
Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal ku'uj yik wach' ol sch'ox t'ayonh tas b'eal ol k'ik'a' yet' tas wach' ol ko k'ulej, xchi heb'.

Ix in tak'wi t'a heb', ix walan icha tik: --Wach' yaji. Ol in lesalwok t'a Jehová ko Diosal eyu'uj, icha ix aj he k'anan chi' t'ayin. Jantaknhej tas ol yal Jehová t'ayin a ol walxi t'ayex. Malaj jab'ok tas ol in k'ub'ejeli, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wixi heb' t'ayin icha tik: --Aokab' Jehová chi' testigo tz'ajkan t'ayonh, tato manh ol ko k'anab'ajej tas ol yal chi' t'ayach.

Tato ol scha ko k'ol tas ol aj spakan Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayach, mato manh ol scha ko k'o'ol, palta ol ko k'anab'ajejnhej tas ol yal chi'. Skal t'ayach to tza k'an t'ay ku'uj yik wach' ol onh elk'ochok, xchi heb'.
Sb'alunhilxo k'uhal chi', ichato chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix wawtejkot winhaj Johanán yet' heb' winh yajal soldado yet' masanil heb' anima, heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi.
Ix walan icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, b'aj ix in tewi yuj tas ix eyal t'ayin, a tz'alan icha tik:

Tato tzex kajnajkan t'a jun lum tik, ol wak'b'at wach'ilal t'a eyib'anh, manhxo ol ex in sateli. Ol wak' k'ib' he b'isul, manhxo ol ex wak' ik'jokb'atok. Yujto ya ix wab' yuj jun niwan yahelal ix wak'b'at t'a eyib'anh tik.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Manhxo ex xiw t'a winh sreyal Babilonia, haton winh b'aj tzex te xiwi. Ha tikne'ik manhxo ex xiwok, yujto ayinnhejek' heyet'ok, ol ex in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Ay wal wok'elk'olal t'ayex. Hanhejtona' ol wak' ok' pax sk'ol jun winh rey chi' t'ayex, ol ex yak'anxi meltzaj winh t'a he chonhab', xchi Jehová.
Palta tato max he k'anab'ajej tas syal Jehová ko Dios chi', tato tzeyal icha tik: Malaj ko gana ko kan t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ol onh b'at t'a Egipto. Hata' ol onh kajnajok, b'aj manhxo ol kil owal, manhxo ol kab' yok' k'e'en trompeta, manhxo ol onh cham yuj wejel, tato xe chi,
yuj chi' ab'ek a ex ayex to kan t'a Judá tik, tas wal syal Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil: Tato tzex ek' wal t'a yib'anh he b'at t'a Egipto chi' yik tzex kajnaj ta' he na'ani,
a owal yet' wejel b'aj tzex xiw chi', ol k'och t'ayex ta'. Hata' ol ex chamok.

Masanil heb' sb'at t'a Egipto yik skajnaj ta', ol cham heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya. Malaj junok mach manh ol chamok, manhxalaj mach ol yal skolan sb'a t'a yahelal ol wak'b'at ta', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal, a tz'alan icha tik: Icha ix aj sja yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, icha wal chi' ol aj sja pax yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh a ex tik, tato ol ex b'at t'a Egipto chi'. Ayik ol ex yilan heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo nación to icha sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' katab'il, icha chi' ol ex ajok, ol xiw heb', ol ex b'uchjok yuj heb'. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol eyilxi jun he lum tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha ex aj Judá ex ixto ex kan tik, a Jehová wan yalan t'ayex yik max ex b'at t'a Egipto chi'. Ojtakejekeli to a in wan walan t'ayex tikne'ik,

te niwan he pitalil wan eyak'anochi, yujto ix he chek in k'anb'ej t'a Jehová ko Diosal, ix eyalan t'ayin icha tik: Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal ku'uj. Ol ak'an kojtakejel masanil tas ol yala', ol ko k'anab'ajani, xe chi.
Toxo ix wak' eyojtakejel tas ix yal Jehová ko Diosal chi', palta max yal pax he k'ol tze k'anab'ajej.
Yuj chi', ojtakejekeli to ol ex cham yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya t'a jun chonhab' b'aj he gana tzex b'atkan chi', xin chi t'a heb'.
